Eggs, bacon, pancakes, hashbrowns — and then the curtain rises 👑🍳 Drag Me to Brunch is coming back to the Main Floor and this time it's all ages, all vibes. Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff hosts a lineup serving up familiar faces from your favorite classic shows and movies, Azúcar style — think nostalgia with a wig and a wink. Doors and food service kick off at 11AM, curtain's at noon sharp. Tickets are NOT available day of, so lock yours in now before this whole thing sells out. Bring the family, bring the friend group, bring your appetite for chaos and carbs 🥞✨ This is brunch like you've never seen it — and once you have, regular brunch just won't hit the same.

Sunday, August 30th • Doors & Food 11AM, Show at Noon
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $5-$20 (advance only, not sold day of)
